description.GyroEnabled: Control the camera or cursor by turning the controller.
description.SensitivityX: How far the camera or cursor moves when you turn left or right.
description.SensitivityY: How far the camera or cursor moves when you tilt up or down.
description.GyroSpace: Which controller movements turn the camera.
choice.space.player: Turn left or right relative to the floor. Tilt forward or back to look up or down.
choice.space.world: Uses the floor as a reference. Vertical movement weakens when the controller is on its side.
choice.space.laser: Aim the front of the controller like a laser pointer.
choice.space.yaw: Turn the controller as if it were flat on a table.
choice.space.roll: Roll the controller like a steering wheel to turn.
choice.space.yaw_roll: Combine the turning movements of Yaw and Roll.
choice.space.local: Adjust the balance between Yaw and Roll.
choice.activation.hold_disable: Hold the chosen control to turn the gyro off.
choice.activation.hold: Hold the chosen control to turn the gyro on.
choice.activation.toggle: Use the chosen control to switch the gyro on or off.
choice.acceleration.off: Keep the same sensitivity at every speed.
choice.acceleration.low: Fast turns are up to 1.5 times more sensitive.
choice.acceleration.medium: Fast turns are up to twice as sensitive.
choice.acceleration.high: Fast turns are up to three times as sensitive.
choice.calibration.menus: Correct drift while the controller is still in a menu.
choice.calibration.anytime: Correct drift whenever the controller is still.
choice.flick.on: Point the right stick to turn, then circle its edge to keep turning.
choice.side.both: Use both sides at the same time.
choice.button.on: Use this button to control the gyro.
description.GyroButton: Button used to control the gyro.
description.GyroTouchpad: Control the gyro by touching the touchpad.
description.GyroStickSensor: Control the gyro by resting a finger on the stick, without clicking.
description.GyroGripSensor: Control the gyro by touching the grip.
description.GyroStick: Control the gyro by tilting the stick.
description.InvertYaw: Reverse left and right for Yaw movements.
description.InvertRoll: Reverse left and right for Roll movements.
description.Smoothing: Reduces shaking. Higher values smooth more but add delay.
description.Acceleration: Quick movements turn farther; slow movements stay precise.
description.AutomaticCalibration: Correct drift when the controller is still.
description.FlickSpinDurationMs: Duration of the initial turn. Zero makes it instant.
calibration.steamHelp: Calibration is managed by Steam Input.
description.BlockLongPress: A short press triggers the game action on release. Holding only controls the gyro.
description.UIScale: Adjust the size of the menu. Automatic adapts to your screen.
description.calibration: Put the controller down and keep it still until calibration finishes.
warning.double: In Steam, turn off gyro-to-mouse and gyro-to-stick to avoid moving twice.
description.RightStickThreshold: How far to tilt the stick to activate it.
description.context.gyro: Choose the game mode that controls the gyro.
description.context.flick: Choose the game mode that controls flick stick.
description.LocalAxisAngle: Main turn axis: 0° for Yaw, 90° for Roll.
description.LocalRollContribution: Amount of the second rotation added. Zero ignores it; negative values reverse it.
ui.sensor.help: Motion sensor paired with your controller.
choice.flick.touchpad: Touch the right pad away from its centre to turn, then circle to keep turning.
choice.flick.both: Use either the right stick or the right touchpad for quick turns.
choice.touchpad.single_on: Touch the touchpad to activate this control.
description.SmoothThreshold: Movements faster than this limit are not smoothed.
description.Tightening: Reduces tiny movements without blocking them. Zero disables this effect.
description.SlowSpeed: Below this speed, the slow sensitivity applies.
description.FastSpeed: Above this speed, the fast sensitivity applies.
description.FlickStyle: Choose an initial pivot, circular turning, or both.
description.FlickSmoothing: Smooths circular turns. Higher values add more delay.
description.FlickSmoothAngle: Angle changes larger than this limit are not smoothed.
description.FlickSnap: Guide the initial turn toward fixed directions.
description.FlickSnapStrength: How strongly a pivot follows the nearest fixed direction.
description.FlickForward: Near the forward direction, start circular turning without a pivot.
description.FlickExponent: Shortens smaller pivots. Zero keeps the same duration for every angle.
description.RecenterButton: Return the camera to a level view.
description.ZoomCompensation: Reduce gyro sensitivity when zooming in.
choice.space.player_lean: Lean sideways to turn. Tilt forward or back to look up or down.
choice.space.world_lean: Lean sideways to turn. Vertical movement stays relative to the floor.
choice.acceleration.custom: Sensitivity follows your chosen slow and fast values.
choice.flick.full: Tilt to pivot, then turn in a circle to rotate.
choice.flick.pivot_only: Tilt to pivot. Circular movements do not turn the camera.
choice.flick.rotate_only: Start turning in a circle without an initial pivot.
choice.flick.snap_off: Use the exact direction you point toward.
choice.flick.snap90: Guide pivots toward forward, back, left or right.
choice.flick.snap45: Guide pivots toward eight directions, including diagonals.
description.GyroTrigger: Choose the trigger that controls the gyro.
description.TriggerThreshold: How far to press the trigger to activate it.
description.FlickSmoothSpeed: Circular turns faster than this are not smoothed.
description.FlickStickInner: Return this close to the centre to allow another pivot.
description.FlickStickOuter: Distance from the centre needed to start a pivot.
description.FlickPadInner: Bring your finger this close to the centre to allow another pivot.
description.FlickPadOuter: Distance from the centre needed to start a pivot.
description.TemporaryInvertButton: Hold this button to reverse the gyro direction.
description.TrackballButton: Keep turning while holding this button to reposition the controller.
description.TrackballDecay: How quickly the continued turn slows. Zero keeps its speed.
description.StickEffect: Effect of the right stick on the gyro.
choice.stick.disables: Suspend the gyro while the right stick is tilted.
choice.stick.enables: Enable the gyro while the right stick is tilted.
description.HoldInvert: Reverse the gyro while holding a chosen control.
description.HoldTrackball: Keep turning while you hold a control to reposition the controller.
inherit.help: Use the settings from another view.
description.recommended: Apply the settings recommended by this mod.
description.RecenterDuration: Time taken to return the camera to a level view. Zero is instant.
description.SteamMouse: Choose what Steam Input mouse movement does.
choice.steam_mouse.pass: Let the game handle the mouse movement.
choice.steam_mouse.convert: Use mouse movement to control the view.
